title: Motion design film
summary: An animated film that sells no product: kinetic typography, a logo ident, music-driven or abstract motion, a title sequence, a collage piece.

notFor.when: the film launches, advertises or sells a product or app
the film teaches an idea or explains how something works
the shots are generated by image or video models
the film is cut from stock or supplied b-roll with type over picture
a teaser or trailer that builds to a reveal, a launch or a date

alternatives.when: the piece is built from cut-out photos, paper and texture (mixed media)

qa: At most three flashes in any one second over 11% of the frame: no FLASH_RISK from flash:check or film:measure
Moving type keeps at least 4.5:1 contrast with the ground under it on every frame it is read
Every word is on screen long enough to read before it leaves, in every format
A logo or mark is the client's own vector, never redrawn, and ends complete and still

intake.ask: Which kind is it: a logo ident, kinetic typography, a lyric video, a title sequence or an abstract music piece?
intake.why: The kind sets the variant, the length and the blocks

intake.ask: Is there a mark or logo, and can you send it as a vector file (SVG, AI or PDF)?
intake.why: A mark is never redrawn or traced; an ident cannot start without the client's own vector
intake.default: no mark: a type-only or abstract piece

intake.ask: Is there a track you own or have licensed, or shall I propose a shortlist at the music step?
intake.why: The music is chosen first and every cut sits on its map
intake.default: a shortlist at the music step (pnpm music)

intake.ask: For a lyric video or a spoken quote: the exact text, and the time each line starts in the track?
intake.why: Agents cannot hear; sung or spoken words land on timings the user supplies
intake.default: not a lyric video: the copy is written at the script step

intake.ask: How does it end: plays once and holds, loops, or hands off to another film?
intake.why: A loop's last frame must match its first; an ident ends complete and still
intake.default: plays once and holds the last frame

profiles.note: 16:9 is the standard; upload at the frame rate it was made at (30). An ident runs 3-5 s, a lyric video the track's length
Square or vertical up to 3 min counts as a Short; the band is a house rule for a type piece that loops
Reels over 3 min are not recommended to new audiences; 9:16 at 1080 x 1920. Keep type out of the UI bands
9:16 recommended; check type against TikTok's safe-zone file before delivery
Meta's guide lists 9:16 at 1080 x 1920 and 1 s to 60 min for feed video; square is the house fallback for the profile grid
An ident or loop in a page header: a silent-safe piece (autoplay is muted), last frame equals first

starter.note: Kinetic type to music: brutalist-mono is described for manifestos, fashion and music. A calm or luxury piece starts from editorial-paper or luxury-serif instead; an ident from kinetic-morph-mark or gather-seal

variants.title: Logo ident or sting
variants.changes: 3-5 s (a 1-2 s sting for social), one idea for how the client's vector mark arrives, ending complete and still on the final downbeat; blocks kinetic-morph-mark, kinetic-line-draw, gather-seal, extruded-mark; a sound logo from sfx:synth in the track's key; a loop version only when asked

variants.title: Kinetic typography
variants.changes: The copy is the picture: one to three words per vertical line at hero size, each landing on a beat or a spoken syllable from the voiceover's word timings; treatment changes with meaning; blocks type-hero-word, type-sentence-build, type-masked-editorial, kinetic-headline-build

variants.title: Lyric video
variants.changes: Length is the track; one sung line on screen at a time, each word on its syllable from the user's timed lyric sheet (agents cannot hear); the singer's or label's written permission for the lyrics and the recording; landscape for YouTube first, vertical cut of the hook second

variants.title: Title sequence or opening titles
variants.changes: 30-90 s landscape; names read at speed in one consistent world built with parallax-rig and focus-pull; every credit held for its reading time, spelled exactly as supplied; the music cue sets the sections
